observations.body: The prayer places God’s name, Kingdom, will, daily bread, forgiveness, and deliverance in sequence.
observations.label: A prayer for the Kingdom to come

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside a prayer for the kingdom to come.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Matthew 6:8–15 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the prayer places God’s name, Kingdom, will, daily bread, forgiveness, and deliverance in sequence. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: A prayer for the Kingdom to come
